name: Crazy Car Racing VR
summary:
Crazy Car Racing VR is a dynamic racing game in virtual reality, where you get behind the wheel of a car and compete with other racing cars for first place. During the race, you can monitor your position, progress through the track, and the number of coins earned using the built‑in game indicators. VR first-person racing
several cars that can be unlocked
computer opponents
coins for winning races
race position display
indicators on the windshield
cars with different speeds and handling features
